meta.display_contract: descriptive display only; forbidden from every predictive or valuation consumer (eFV, xFV, projections, FA, surplus, trade value, readiness); prospx card + glossary are the only consumers
meta.ladder_note: ap_ ladder scale, Rk folds CPX+DSL at the sportId 16 grain; NOT the eFV level_rank scale
meta.scale: 100 = typical peer-adjusted ladder pace for a comparable path; 110 is one standard unit faster; never percentage language

value_keys.ap_plus_display: ap_plus clipped to 70-130 for display only
value_keys.note: the clamp is a display convention, so it rides its own key; ap_plus is never the clamped number

meta.panel: hitters, entry cohorts 2015+ from .cache/milb_stats hitting files 2014-2026; 2014 is the left-censor guard year
meta.footnote_2020: 2020 minor-league season cancelled; never counted as development time
meta.footnote_2026: 2026 reflects the season in progress through the latest stats cache refresh
divergences: entry cohorts 2015+ with 2014 guard (source panel: 2009+ with 2008 guard, deeper feeds)
position group from games shares in positions_played.json (source: innings-weighted primary position); uncovered players form an UNK adjustment bucket
draft tables start 2017, so 2015-16 entries classify by the DSL-league / entry-age pathway heuristic
starting level = lowest-rank meaningful level of the first meaningful season (source: max-PA level); season aggregates carry no stint order and the max-PA rule mislabels within-season year-1 climbers
